div.head: I Atr 3.1
div.ab: Gif hit þonne hwa dó, fo se landhlaford to ⁊ healde þæt orf, oð þæt mon wite, hwa hit age mid rihte.
And gyf hit hwá do, fo se landhlaford to ⁊ healde þæt órf, oð þæt mon wite, hwa hit mid rihte áge.
Si quis hoc presumat, capiat illud terre dominus et custodiat pecus illud, donec sciatur, cuius sit secundum rectum.
And gyf hit hwa do, fo se landhlaford to ⁊ healde þæt órf, oð þæt mon wite hwa hit mid rihte áge.
And if anyone do so, the lord of the manor shall seize and keep the stock, until it is known who is the rightful owner.
Jedoch (Und B) wenn das jemand thut, nehme der Grund-[und Immunitäts]herr und halte das Vieh, bis dass man weiss, wem es rechtmässig gehört.
But (And, B) if anyone does it, let the [immunity-]landlord seize and keep the cattle until it is known to whom it rightfully belongs.
